conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 2. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 14.2 | 7.1 | 600 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 10.8 | 5.4 | 600 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 13.7 | 6.8 | 600 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
